sn35.235:1.3: Katamo ca so bhikkhave ādittapariyāyo dhammapariyāyo || || 2
sn35.235:1.4: Varam bhikkhave tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhundriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ || na tveva cakkhuviññeyesu rūpesu anuvyañjanaso nimittaggāho || ||
sn35.235:1.5: Nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇam tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anuvyañjanassādagadhitam vā || tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati || yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:1.7: Imaṃ khvāham bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi || ||
sn35.235:2.1: Varam bhikkhave tiṇhena ayosaṃkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena sotindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ || na tveva sotaviññeyyesu saddesu anuvyañjanaso nimittaggāho ||
sn35.235:2.2: nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anuvyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā || tasmiṃ ce samaye kālam kareyya ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati || yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnam aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:2.4: Imaṃ khvāham bhikkhave ādīnavam disvā evaṃ vadāmi || ||
sn35.235:3.1: Varam bhikkhave tiṇhena nakhacchedanena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena ghānindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ || na tveva ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu anuvyañjanaso nimittaggāho || ||
sn35.235:3.2: Nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anuvyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā || tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya
sn35.235:3.3: ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati || yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:3.5: Imaṃ khvāham bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi || ||
sn35.235:4.1: Varam bhikkhave tiṇhena khurena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena jivhindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ na tveva jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu anuvyañjanaso nimittaggāho ||
sn35.235:4.2: Nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇam tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya || anuvyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā || tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya ||
sn35.235:4.3: ṭhānam etaṃ vijjati || yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnam aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:4.5: Imaṃ khvāham bhikkhave ādīnavaṃ disvā evaṃ vadāmi ||
sn35.235:5.1: Varam bhikkhave tiṇhāya sattiyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya kāyindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ || na tveva kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu anuvyañjanaso nimittaggāho || ||
sn35.235:5.2: Nimittassādagadhitaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya anuvyañjanassādagadhitaṃ vā || tasmiṃ ce samaye kālaṃ kareyya
sn35.235:5.3: ṭhānam etam vijjati || yaṃ dvinnaṃ gatīnam aññataraṃ gatiṃ gaccheyya
sn35.235:5.5: Imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave ādīnavam disvā evam vadāmi || ||
sn35.235:6.2: suttaṃ kho panāham bhikkhave vañjhaṃ jīvitānam vadāmi aphalaṃ jīvitānaṃ vadāmi momūhaṃ jīvitānam vadāmi || na tveva tathārūpe vitakke vitakkeyya yathārūpānaṃ vitakkānaṃ vasaṃgato saṅgham bhindeyya || ||
sn35.235:6.3: Imam khvāham bhikkhave vañjhaṃ jīvitānam ādīnavam disvā evaṃ vadāmi || || 8
sn35.235:7.1: Tattha bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati || ||
sn35.235:7.2: Tiṭṭhatu tāva tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhundriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ ||
sn35.235:7.4: Iti cakkhum aniccaṃ rūpā aniccā cakkhuviññāṇam aniccaṃ || cakkhusamphasso anicco || yam pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tam pi aniccaṃ || || 9
sn35.235:8.1: Tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhena ayosaṃkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena sotindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ ||
sn35.235:8.3: Iti sotam aniccaṃ saddā aniccā sotaviññāṇam aniccaṃ sotasamphasso anicco || yam pidaṃ sotasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tam pi aniccaṃ || || 10
sn35.235:9.1: Tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhena nakhacchedanena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena ghānindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ ||
sn35.235:9.3: Iti ghānam aniccaṃ gandhā aniccā ghānaviññāṇam aniccaṃ ghānasamphasso anicco || yam pidaṃ ghānasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ || la || tam pi aniccaṃ || || 11
sn35.235:10.1: Tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhena khurena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena jivhindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ ||
sn35.235:10.3: Iti jivhā aniccā rasā aniccā jivhāviññāṇam aniccaṃ jivhāsamphasso anicco || yam pidam jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ || pe || tam pi aniccaṃ || || 12
sn35.235:11.1: Tiṭṭhatu tāva tiṇhāya sattiyā ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya kāyindriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭham ||
sn35.235:11.3: Iti kāyo anicco phoṭṭhabbā aniccā kāyaviññāṇam aniccaṃ kāyasamphasso anicco || Yam pidaṃ kāyasamphassapaccayā || pe || tam pi aniccaṃ || || 13
sn35.235:12.3: Iti mano anicco dhammā aniccā manoviññāṇam aniccaṃ manosamphasso anicco || yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tam pi aniccaṃ || || 14
sn35.235:13.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃ nibbindati rūpesu nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇe pi nibbindati cakkhusamphasse pi nibbindati || pe ||
sn35.235:13.2: yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tasmim pi nibbindati || ||
sn35.235:13.3: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamhīti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn35.235:13.4: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karanīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || 15
